candidate_digest_rule: L2 section from `### ID` until next `###`; trim trailing blank lines and terminate with one UTF-8 LF.
paired_acceptance_digest_rule: L11 candidate section from its exact `### IDのL11受入候補（未実行）` heading until next `###`; trim trailing blank lines and terminate with one UTF-8 LF.
source_atom_set_digest_rule: SHA-256 over ordered UTF-8 lines `atom_id` + space + `sha256:`-prefixed `source_span_sha256`, joined by LF without trailing LF.
source_collection_scope: BRAIN L1から導く新規知識候補。旧sourceはHARNESS候補の限定入力にのみ割当て、本候補は直接legacy input 0件。空集合のno_lossであり、旧意味の継承・closureではない。
